    Designed for you to get more done

    Capture and organize every idea

    Capture notes quickly and organize them however you want, wherever you are. With simple checklists or full project boards, get a clear view of what’s on your plate so nothing slips through the cracks.

    Work without friction

    Notion’s editing experience is distraction-free, drag-and-drop flexible, and powered by AI that can draft, edit, and improve alongside you. Powerful connectors let your bring all that context with you, wherever you work.

    Collaborate and share

    Add guests to your travel itinerary, share a public link to your book club’s reading list, or publish your resume as a website. When you’re ready for a shared workspace, add members and work on everything together.

    Questions & answers

    Is Notion free for personal use?

    Yes, with the free plan you can get started with the basics in Notion and capture notes, organize projects, and even try Notion AI.

    Upgrade to Plus for bigger file uploads, longer page history, and more guests. Nothing you've built moves or breaks.

    What’s the best way to get started with Notion?

    You must be a non-paying Notion customer, with less than 50 employees and under $10M in funding from an accredited investor. See full terms and conditions.

    Can I import my notes or projects from other tools?

    Yes, it’s easy to import your data from Google Docs, Evernote, Trello and more. Learn more about importing your data.

    Can I work offline in Notion?

    Yes, with offline mode you can choose which pages to download and access them anywhere. On paid plans, your Recents and Favorites auto-download so you can always find what you need on-the-go.

    Does Notion work well for students?

    Yes, Notion has an Education Plan. With the Education Plan, students can organize plans, tasks and notes across school and life with customizable pages & blocks, file uploads, more features to configure and publish your site, and 30-day version history.

    The Education Plan for individual students is a free plan for a one-member workspace. It’s available for students signed in with their education institution’s email per the WHED.

    What happened to the Personal Plan and Personal Pro?

    They’ve been retired. Notion now has four plans: Free, Plus, Business, and Enterprise. If you were on one of the old personal plans, you’ve been moved to a current plan. Check Settings → Billing to see which, and compare them here.
